description:
Requires Lazylib.

This mod is a continuation/fork of AppleMarineXX's original UNSC mod.

READ THIS SECTION FIRST

This is the same mod as

UNSC Continued

, however

after

releasing the first version, I realized there were two other UNSC continuations that already existed,

Halo HomeSystems

and

UNSC Reborn

. Both of those mods have a lot more Halo content and were released before this fork was. Out of respect for that, and out of an unquenchable desire for compatibility, I decided to do a full namespace/ID migration for this fork, to make it possible for UNSC Core Continued, and the other 2 UNSC/Halo mods to coexist in the same game.

Now Compatible with the other UNSC forks

So this mod is now compatible with both UNSC Reborn and Halo Homesystems. However,

those two mods DO conflict with each other

, so you'll have to pick between those two. As of right now, UNSC Reborn also adds its own Epsilon Eridani system, so I would personally recommend Halo HomeSystems, since it actually retains the New Reach custom made UNSC system that was originally from the AppleMarineXX version, without adding it's own Epsilon Eridani. If you use UNSC Reborn, both Epsilon Eridani's will exist peacefully (code wise) but it may be a bit confusing or weird to see both systems with the same name. (possible solution to that soon)

I have made a few tweaks to help visually distinguish this UNSC faction from the others:

This mod's faction is now named UNSC Core, and this name is also applied to blueprint/codex/everywhere else so this factions stuff does not get mixed in with the other UNSC mod's.Faction flag has been given a unique UNSC flag to help distinguish visually.UNSC Core has a Green/white identifier to help visually separate UNSC Core fleets from the other mod's fleets.

NOT Save Compatible with 1.3.1

UNSC Core Continued 2.0.0 is NOT compatible with saves using UNSC Continued 1.3.1 or earlier.

This is why you are seeing 2.0.0 in a new thread with a separate Github repo.

I did not want people to accidentally upgrade their 1.3.1 mod to 2.0.0 without seeing this info, as it will break the save without migrations done first. If I kept this new version in the same thread & repo, it would have caused frustration for anyone updating through TriOS or didn't check the OP in full.

Migrating 1.3.1 (Continued) to 2.0.0 (Core Continued)

Step 1:

If using version 1.03.0/1.3.0, update to 1.3.1 first, load the save you want to migrate, then

save with 1.3.1 active BEFORE trying to migrate

. Using migrator before completing this step

WILL FAIL

.

There are a couple migration options to pick from.

In the 2.0.0 Release page

, you will find:

Option 1: Powershell Script (Windows)

- This is a downloadable zip with a command prompt and instructions. Extract it somewhere and point it at your 1.3.1 save and it will create a migrated copy for you. Unfortunately since it is a powershell script, it will also likely trigger Antivirus warnings up your wazoo, because many of them just auto-flag powershell scripts as such, regardless of their contents. It might also cause your parents to disown you, and could lead to your PC being haunted by the ghost of General Custer. If you are willing to risk it, I already used it myself a few times, and it worked without lighting my computer on fire, and have so far not needed to perform any voodoo cleansing rituals.

Option 2: LLM Conversion package

- This is a zip with an AI/LLM prompt in a text file and a migration map .json file. The idea with this is you give an LLM of your choice a zip of your 1.3.1 save file, along with the json migration map, and paste the prompt in the text file into the LLM. It theoretically should give it the ability to migrate your save and spit back a converted 2.0.0 ready save you can load up with 2.0.0 installed.

I have tested this with Chat GPT using 5.6 Sol on High (in Chat Mode) and it works great. Lower thinking levels/models should still work but I'd recommend at least Medium.

I tried it with Gemini and it was straight poopooass because Gemini wouldn't even recognize I was attaching the files in the chat. If you pay for a better version it might work. I haven't tried it with other LLMs yet, but if you do, please let me know your results.

Option 3: I Gotchu Homie

If Powershell is too spoopy and you cant get the LLM to work, send me your save files and I'll convert them for you. You can post them in this thread, DM me a download link, or send it to me on Discord. You can find me on discord in the

Unofficial Starsector Discord

as OP of

the UNSC CC Discord thread

.

Changelog for v2.0.0 (Core Continued) (October 9, 2026)

Full Namespace & ID migration: "unsc_core_continued" / "unsc_cc" / "unsc_cc_" etcCompatibility validated with UNSC Reborn 0.6.5 and Halo HomeSystems 0.7.6.Dedicated "UNSC Core" simulator category. UNSC Core ships no longer show up under "Default" in simulator.Ship hulls, LPC and Weapons now appear under "UNSC Core" in Codex/production UICorrected Sabre/Longsword Autofit and NPC carrier-wing population.Replacement faction flag/crest/package art and green/white segmented faction presentation.Added civilian logistics (Fuel/Cargo/Crew Transport) access for trade/invasion/expedition-style fleets.If another star system exists where Epsilon Eridani wants to spawn, Epsilon Eridani will automatically move over during world gen to prevent overlap.

Previous Version Change-logs:

Spoiler

Version 1.3.1 Changes (Legacy Continued) (October 7, 2026)

Added Treasure Hunt 2.3.0 integration for the UNSC Blueprint Package one-time reward pool.Added custom descriptions for Epsilon Eridani I, Circumstance, Beta Gabriel, Tantalus, and Site 17.Added a 128x128 project icon for TriOS and similar launchers/managers.Removed dead UNSC_hullconstruction description-parameter code without changing the hullmod's gameplay effects.Normalized the public and Version Checker version identity to 1.3.1.

Version 1.3.0 (First Public Release/Legacy Continued) (September 18, 2026)

Reworked and expanded home system into a recreation of Epsilon Eridani (Reach's solar system)Added exploration locations, caches, debris fields, and UNSC wrecks to home systemAdded optional Industrial Evolution integration. If IndEvo is enabled, Reach will have a Railgun Artillery StationStandardized UNSC internal content IDs for better long-term maintainability & stabilityCreated optional Nexerelin colony-expedition naming support. If Nex is installed, new UNSC colonies on planets with generic names (system name #) will get renamed from a special pool of planet names from the Halo universe.Fixed several small inherited world-generation and compatibility issuesCleaned up obsolete files and rebuilt the Java portion of the mod against current dependenciesResolved an issue where a bundled lazylib library was causing some glitchy behavior in the consoleHigher resolution ship hull and fighter hull graphics.Removed Unused FilesVersion Checker (lunalib) support

[close]

Installation

Download the release ZIP and extract the contained folder into your Starsector mods directory.

Make sure you migrate any 1.3.1 saves first (see above).

*This fork

IS

compatible with

Halo HomeSystems

or

UNSC Reborn

. You can only pick one of those however to run with UNSC Core Continued, as they are not compatible with each other.

Enable LazyLib along with any optional supported mods you wish to use.

If you encounter any bugs, please post your log here, a screenshot of the error, and if possible your mod list and I will work on it ASAP.

Optional mod integrations:

NexerelinIndustrial EvolutionTreasure HuntCommissioned CrewsStarpocalypse

Mod Feature Highlights:

New Ship Graphics[close]Epsilon Eridani[close]Nexerelin Expeditions Get Custom Planet NamesThis mod has a special script when used with Nexerelin. If the UNSC Core faction colonizes a generic named planet (Beta Aquilae I, II, IV, etc), the planet will be renamed from a pool of Halo themed planet names from Halo lore. The pool is deterministic, so this will always happen in the same order (Like how towns are named in the Civilization games). If they colonize a unique named planet, the script will not fire, leaving the unique planet name intact. There is a slight delay to this, so you may see the name change after a few in game seconds. Side effect of the delayed naming is that Expedition notifications will retain the name that Nexellerin chose for the planet, which is different than what it will get renamed to. If a name on the list is already used elsewhere in the sector, that name will be skipped.

This script was designed with performance in mind, and uses a very optimized method to do this. When I logged duty usage over a few hours of testing, it came out to 0.00003% CPU time, or approximately

1.2 milliseconds of CPU time per hour of gameplay

.

[close]

Changelog for v2.0.0 (Core Continued) (October 9, 2026)
  • Full Namespace & ID migration: "unsc_core_continued" / "unsc_cc" / "unsc_cc_" etc
  • Compatibility validated with UNSC Reborn 0.6.5 and Halo HomeSystems 0.7.6.
  • Dedicated "UNSC Core" simulator category. UNSC Core ships no longer show up under "Default" in simulator.
  • Ship hulls, LPC and Weapons now appear under "UNSC Core" in Codex/production UI
  • Corrected Sabre/Longsword Autofit and NPC carrier-wing population.
  • Replacement faction flag/crest/package art and green/white segmented faction presentation.
  • Added civilian logistics (Fuel/Cargo/Crew Transport) access for trade/invasion/expedition-style fleets.
  • If another star system exists where Epsilon Eridani wants to spawn, Epsilon Eridani will automatically move over during world gen to prevent overlap.

Previous Version Change-logs:
SpoilerVersion 1.3.1 Changes (Legacy Continued) (October 7, 2026)
  • Added Treasure Hunt 2.3.0 integration for the UNSC Blueprint Package one-time reward pool.
  • Added custom descriptions for Epsilon Eridani I, Circumstance, Beta Gabriel, Tantalus, and Site 17.
  • Added a 128x128 project icon for TriOS and similar launchers/managers.
  • Removed dead UNSC_hullconstruction description-parameter code without changing the hullmod's gameplay effects.
  • Normalized the public and Version Checker version identity to 1.3.1.

Version 1.3.0 (First Public Release/Legacy Continued) (September 18, 2026)
  • Reworked and expanded home system into a recreation of Epsilon Eridani (Reach's solar system)
  • Added exploration locations, caches, debris fields, and UNSC wrecks to home system
  • Added optional Industrial Evolution integration. If IndEvo is enabled, Reach will have a Railgun Artillery Station
  • Standardized UNSC internal content IDs for better long-term maintainability & stability
  • Created optional Nexerelin colony-expedition naming support. If Nex is installed, new UNSC colonies on planets with generic names (system name #) will get renamed from a special pool of planet names from the Halo universe.
  • Fixed several small inherited world-generation and compatibility issues
  • Cleaned up obsolete files and rebuilt the Java portion of the mod against current dependencies
  • Resolved an issue where a bundled lazylib library was causing some glitchy behavior in the console
  • Higher resolution ship hull and fighter hull graphics.
  • Removed Unused Files
  • Version Checker (lunalib) support

Make sure you migrate any 1.3.1 saves first (see above).
